entities.name: Douglas H. Ginsburg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Douglas Howard Ginsburg is an American lawyer and jurist serving as a senior U.S. circuit judge of the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. He is also a professor of law at the Antonin Scalia Law School of George Mason University.
